greeting.suffix: ! I am Parul — your Relationship Manager.

strings: Two behaviours worth knowing: from the app the page lands straight on the video and plays itself — no menu, no chrome. And because browsers block audio until the page is touched, if nothing is audible ~1.5s in, the pro gets one clear “Tap to turn on sound” tap and it replays from the top with sound. This page opens as the video from any entry point — press T or add ?team=1 to bring this commentary panel back.

• Easy: straight, then one turn.
  • Medium: straight looks possible but the board says turn — the marker goes red. “Trust the board, not your eyes.”
  • Hard: locked screen with the voice still talking, then a missed turn → Maps silently re-routes → arrival → back to the app and the purple button.

The pro meets a named person, not an app. Parul is framed as their RM — the same relationship they already trust offline. She sets three expectations up front: no reading needed, five minutes, and a quiz at the end.

The spotlight dims everything except the one element being taught, so attention has nowhere else to go. Cues are always shape and colour — “the colourful icon”, “the purple button”, “the green board” — never “read this word”.
And this purple button at the bottom — “Mark Aa Gaya”. Press it only when you reach the customer’s home. Not now. Remember — purple means you have arrived.
On the right, this speaker icon. If you cannot hear the voice, tap it once. Then Maps will speak — “In two hundred meters, turn left.”
If the map shifts around and the blue arrow stops being visible, press this white button on the left. The blue arrow will come back to the centre.
And now the most important button — this dark green button at the bottom left. Press it. From here, Maps starts speaking and guiding you.
You will also see light grey lines. Those are other routes, a little longer. Ignore them — the dark blue line is yours.
And at the end there will be five small questions. I will ask the question, and you have to tap the right answer on the screen — press it with your finger.

Watch what happens. Maps does not get angry. It quietly makes a new route for you — this new blue line.
